title: Étale cohomology of a field as discrete Galois cohomology
statement: Let K : Type u be a field, Ω : Type u a separably closed field with a separable algebraic K-algebra structure, and F an abelian étale sheaf on Spec K valued in AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}. Write M for its geometric fibre at Ω with the natural discrete Gal(Ω/K)-action. For every n ∈ ℕ there is an additive equivalence Hⁿ(Spec K_et,F) ≃ Extⁿ_DiscreteModule(Gal(Ω/K))(ℤ,M).

source.place: Tag 03QU, lemma-compare-cohomology-point; Tags 04JQ and 04JM for the additive equivalence and sections

proof.text: Let K be a field and Ω a separably closed separable algebraic extension. The geometric fibre point is a Galois point: every étale geometric point is represented over a finite separable intermediate extension, embeddings extend to automorphisms, and the stabilizer of an embedding is its open fixing subgroup. The source module proves this directly as isGaloisPoint_galoisPoint, using étale residue fields and extension of embeddings.

The fibre functor is therefore an additive equivalence from all abelian étale sheaves to discrete Gal(Ω/K)-modules, not just modules killed by one integer. Sections become invariant fibres. An equivalence preserves short exact sequences and injectives. Apply it to an injective resolution; the sections complex becomes the invariants complex. Taking degree-n cohomology gives the additive equivalence of sheaf H with Extⁿ from the trivial integer module. This is exactly the existing declaration sheafHAddEquivGaloisH, whose source proof is the Galois-point Ext comparison.
